Legal documents

The same documents the app shows and asks you to accept.

KinesioCal has two sets of terms, because two kinds of people use it:

  • Providers — the businesses and practitioners who subscribe and run their practice on KinesioCal — accept the Provider Terms of Service (and, during the beta, the Beta Tester Agreement; the Automatic Renewal Terms each time a paid plan starts or changes).
  • Clients — the people who book appointments or hold a portal account with one of those businesses — accept the Client Terms of Use.

Everyone is covered by the one Privacy Policy.

All documents

  • Provider Terms of Service — The agreement a business (the provider) accepts when it signs up. Last updated 11/9/2026.
  • Client Terms of Use — The terms a client accepts when booking an appointment or creating a portal account. Last updated 11/9/2026.
  • Privacy Policy — How KinesioCal handles personal information. Accepted by businesses and clients. Last updated 11/11/2026.
  • Beta Tester Agreement & NDA — Accepted by every business that signs up during the beta. Last updated 11/9/2026.
  • Automatic Renewal Terms — Accepted by a business every time it starts or changes a paid plan. Last updated 11/9/2026.
